comment: Tests of the in-tree modules that read or import trees the kernel does not hold. Each is excluded from `pnpm --filter ./modules/<id> test` via `node scripts/check-module-source-scan.mjs --coupled-excludes <id>`, and is the scan's only allowance for a non-Dockerfile coupling — per finding: "allows" lists the exact targets (repo-relative paths; a directory covers what is under it; '.' is the repository root itself) the file may reach. The list fails on a missing reason or owner, a nonexistent path, or an entry the scan finds no coupling in (stale). Currently empty: the two StuRaOS-only tests it held (publishing deploy-drift, votes aggregator-parity) were removed from the kernel copy by R29-KHYG2-K (see modules/EXTRACTION-DELTA.json), so every module's unit `test` script collects all its files.
